description: Search articles using hybrid semantic and lexical search. Returns matching articles with title, snippet, and relevance score, best match first (higher score = more relevant).

dateFrom.description: Filter by start date (ISO format, e.g., 2024-01-01)

dateTo.description: Filter by end date (ISO format, e.g., 2024-12-31)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page (1-1000)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (use with limit to page through all results)

name: search_articles
title: Search Articles
